limitations: Available evaluations cover selected systems and attack settings.

conditions: every model since his Christmas Day 2022 writing

statement.excerpt: The link above happens to be about something that I wrote in 2022, on Christmas Day, anticipating the release of GPT-4, but the key point is this: it has been true of every model since. Hundreds of them.
statement.document_title: BREAKING: Employees at OpenAI and Anthropic are panicking

our_interpretation: The population is LLMs released after the Christmas Day 2022 article and before this post.
The ordinary reading is that each model exhibits material unsafe behavior and unreliable behavioral control. Merely making an occasional factual error would not establish both properties.
The target period follows the retrospective period explicitly identified in the surrounding text.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the claimed population establishes material unsafe behavior and failures of behavioral control in every model.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible counterexample shows a model with reliably constrained behavior across sufficiently broad ordinary-use and adversarial evaluations. Passing one narrow test would not suffice.
